# The Light House Diving Center

> Premier diving center and PADI/CMAS courses based in Hurghada, Red Sea, Egypt. Offering daily diving excursions, specialized dive training, wreck dives, and boat trips.

## Main Services & Pages

- [Home](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en): Overview of diving packages, daily dive schedules, and direct bookings.
- [About Us](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/about): Center history, certified team, boat facilities, and safety standards.
- [Daily Diving & Snorkeling](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/daily-diving): Guided daily boat dives, house reef diving, and snorkeling excursions.
- [Diving Courses](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/diving-courses): Complete catalog of beginner, advanced, and specialty diving certifications.

## Popular Courses & Certifications

- [PADI Open Water Diver](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/padi-open-water-diver-course): Entry-level certification including full theory, confined water training, and open sea dives.
- [PADI Advanced Open Water Diver](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/padi-advanced-open-water-diver-course): Deep dive and navigation training with elective adventure dives.
- [PADI Enriched Air Nitrox Diver](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/enriched-air-nitrox-diver): Specialty course to extend bottom times and dive safely with higher oxygen blends.
- [PADI Rescue Diver](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/padi-rescue-diver-course): Problem management, emergency response, and diver rescue techniques.

## Popular Trips & Dive Sites

- [Sunken City Shore Dive](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/sunken-city-shore-dive): Shore dive exploring underwater architecture in Sahl Hasheesh.
- [Salem Express Wreck Dive](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/salem-express-wreck): Historic wreck exploration for experienced advanced divers.

## Contact & Direct Bookings

- [Contact & Location](https://www.thelighthousee.com/en/contact): Center address in Hurghada, WhatsApp booking links, and daily operational hours.
